findings.title: Filter completed pages by actual sync identity, not absent conversation_id
findings.body: sync_completed_pages has only sync_id, sequence, page_index, page_hash, completed_at. The conversation_id filter empties observations.phone_pages despite 225 retained rows. report.md:54 points to this empty summary for durable-page/ACK evidence. Two cited sync IDs have retained completed rows; third reopen sync has saved partial ACK but no row in the earlier retained snapshot. This is an evidence/reporting defect, not proof of product commit failure, and original self-checks missed it.
findings.recommendation: Append a correction with existing server conversationKey/syncId and actual sequence/pageIndex/pageHash mapping; include two actual rows, qualify the third ACK without post-commit snapshot, add non-vacuous evidence self-check. Preserve original event/blobs and no business rerun/source repair.
